## City Council

*The Shoshone City Council is the governmental body the oversees the functions of City.*  
*​The City Council is made up of four city council members and the city mayor.* ​

* * *

**The City Council meets the 1st and 3rd Tuesday of each month at 7:00 P.M.**   
**If you would like to be added to the agenda please contact City Hall at 208-886-2030.**

[Agenda and Minutes](https://www.shoshonecityid.gov/agenda--minutes.html)
